description: The Ceribell EEG System is an FDA cleared, AI-powered, neurodiagnostic platform that enables bedside diagnosis and real-time monitoring of suspected seizure patients. The SaaS EEG portal enables real-time streaming of Ceribell EEG data to allow physicians to securely review from anywhere. The cloud-hosted portal also powers continuous AI monitoring that provides a real-time Seizure Burden trendline and alerts indicating suspected status epilepticus.
